title: Saudi Arabia Calls for Comprehensive Regional Navigation Security Framework
detail: Saudi Arabia called for 'comprehensive' regional navigation security at a multilateral forum, signaling Riyadh's intent to push for a broader framework to protect maritime routes amid the Hormuz crisis. The move reflects growing Saudi urgency to stabilize Hormuz-dependent shipping lanes and food supply corridors.

media.caption: Saudi Arabia pushes for comprehensive regional navigation security at multilateral forum
